## What each role may read and write

### `architect`  Chief architect (CTO)
Owns technical coherence. Writes ADRs, plans phases and tasks, reviews merges, re-plans stuck tasks. In the lean preset also covers delivery, devops and cost modelling.

- tools: read, write, bash, web
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/adr/**`, `.venture/artifacts/backlog/**`, `.venture/artifacts/audit/**`, `.venture/artifacts/cost-model/**`, `.venture/artifacts/release-report/**`, `.venture/work/*/task.md`, `.venture/work/architect/**`, `.venture/work/legal/**`, `.venture/work/delivery/**`, `.venture/work/devops/**`, `infra/**`, `deploy/**`, `.github/**`, `Dockerfile*`, `docker-compose*.yml`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `auditor`  Blind auditor
Reviews a change against the spec using only the spec, tests, diff and CI result. Structurally cannot read the implementer's notes. In the lean preset it also writes the red-team gate challenges.

- tools: read, write, web
- reads: `**`, `!.venture/work/*/result.md`, `!.venture/work/*/scratch/**`, `!.venture/work/*/test-dispute.md`, `!.venture/state/**`, `!.venture/questions/**`, `!.venture/ledger.jsonl`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/audit/**`, `.venture/artifacts/redteam/**`, `.venture/work/redteam/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `compliance-analyst`  Compliance analyst
Maps the target market and data types to the regulatory regimes that apply and the obligations they create.

- tools: read, write, web
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/compliance-map/**`, `.venture/work/compliance/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `delivery-manager`  Delivery manager (COO)
Breaks the approved design into sprints and tasks with a dependency graph; writes the release report with run metrics.

- tools: read, write, bash
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/backlog/**`, `.venture/artifacts/release-report/**`, `.venture/work/*/task.md`, `.venture/work/delivery/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `devops`  Infrastructure and delivery (CIO)
Hosting choice, CI pipeline, environments, secrets handling, deploy and rollback.

- tools: read, write, bash, web
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/adr/**`, `.venture/work/devops/**`, `infra/**`, `deploy/**`, `.github/**`, `Dockerfile*`, `docker-compose*.yml`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `engineer-junior`  Junior engineer
Implements low-complexity, tightly specified tasks (glue code, CRUD, config, docs). Same rules as the senior engineer.

- tools: read, write, bash
- reads: `**`, `!.venture/ledger.jsonl`
- writes: `**`, `!@tests`, `!.venture/**`, `.venture/work/*/result.md`, `.venture/work/*/scratch/**`, `.venture/work/*/test-dispute.md`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `engineer-senior`  Senior engineer
Implements one task against locked tests. Cannot edit tests or artifacts. Runs CI through the runtime wrapper.

- tools: read, write, bash
- reads: `**`, `!.venture/ledger.jsonl`
- writes: `**`, `!@tests`, `!.venture/**`, `.venture/work/*/result.md`, `.venture/work/*/scratch/**`, `.venture/work/*/test-dispute.md`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `finance-legal`  Finance and legal
Cost model (hosting, APIs, fees, support), unit economics and licence or contract flags. Not legal advice.

- tools: read, write, web
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/cost-model/**`, `.venture/work/legal/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `market-researcher`  Market researcher
Answers one research question with sourced notes. Spawned in parallel by the strategy head.

- tools: read, write, web
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/work/research/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `marketing-head`  Chief Marketing Officer
Positioning, channels, pricing hypothesis and launch plan, built from the market brief and PRD.

- tools: read, write, web
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/gtm-plan/**`, `.venture/work/marketing/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `orchestrator`  Orchestrator (CEO)
Runs the swarm as a thin state machine. Dispatches roles, enforces gates and budgets, batches questions for the human. Never produces artifacts or code.

- tools: read, write, spawn
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/state/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `product-head`  Chief Product Officer
Owns what gets built. Writes the PRD with testable acceptance criteria and compiles the one-page decision pack for the human.

- tools: read, write
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/prd/**`, `.venture/artifacts/decision-pack/**`, `.venture/work/product/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `qa`  QA engineer
Writes the tests before any code, from the acceptance criteria. Arbitrates test disputes. Tests are locked when QA finishes.

- tools: read, write, bash
- reads: `**`, `!.venture/ledger.jsonl`
- writes: `@tests`, `.venture/artifacts/test-plan/**`, `.venture/work/*/qa-*.md`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `red-team`  Red team
Standing dissenter. Argues against each gate decision before the human sees it; its dissent is logged, never voted away.

- tools: read, write, web
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/redteam/**`, `.venture/work/redteam/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `security-engineer`  Security engineer
Specialist for one deep dive (auth flow, data store, a dependency set, a scanner run). Spawned by the security lead.

- tools: read, write, bash, web
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/work/security/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `security-lead`  Security lead (CISO)
Threat model at design time, independent security audit and veto at build time. In the lean preset also maps compliance obligations.

- tools: read, write, bash, web
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/threat-model/**`, `.venture/artifacts/compliance-map/**`, `.venture/artifacts/audit/**`, `.venture/work/security/**`, `.venture/work/compliance/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `source-verifier`  Source verifier
Independently re-opens every cited source in the market brief and checks it says what the brief claims. Cannot see the researchers' notes.

- tools: read, write, web
- reads: `**`, `!.venture/work/**`, `!.venture/state/**`, `!.venture/ledger.jsonl`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/verification/**`, `.venture/questions/**`

### `strategy-head`  Chief Strategy Officer
Turns the brief into a cited market brief and an evidence plan that names real-world tests. Applies strategy frameworks only where evidence supports them.

- tools: read, write, web
- reads: `**`
- writes: `.venture/artifacts/market-brief/**`, `.venture/artifacts/evidence-plan/**`, `.venture/artifacts/gtm-plan/**`, `.venture/work/research/**`, `.venture/work/strategy/**`, `.venture/work/marketing/**`, `.venture/questions/**`
